_comment: Run: python cx_reach.py --explain-hints for the full explanation. Optional. Maps a CVE to the classes/packages that contain the vulnerable code (from the advisory or the fix commit). With a hint, the script can tell REACHABLE apart from USED-SAFE?. Class-level only: a referenced class is not proof the vulnerable method is called.

CVE-2022-1471.note: SnakeYAML: exploitable when parsing untrusted YAML with the default Constructor; SafeConstructor is fine
